boundaries.first_audio: SpeechMessageEvent creation to first HTTP PCM / first nonzero PCM write / virtual source20ms read with peak>64/32768; common monotonic clock
boundaries.silence: Just before cancel/mute/server kill to first read of a >=2s continuously silent interval; common monotonic clock
boundaries.silence_case_observation: Cancellation and server-crash latencies are virtual-source measurements while VRChat stays connected; those partial utterances are not separately recorded via the VRChat replay test.
boundaries.replay: Normal3 and recovery3: each request actual HTTP PCM compared to source capture and isolated VRChat microphone-test digital replay; exactly one envelope match expected.
boundaries.mute: Source all samples zero during23.989s capture; rejected new TTS does not invoke inference; known replay occurrences0. The raw exactly-once comparator verdict=fail is expected for zero occurrences and is retained unchanged.
boundaries.precision: 20ms frames, peak threshold, generated leading silence and OS scheduling apply; decimal digits are not physical accuracy. HTTP PCM may be zero; column differences are not pure OS latency.
boundaries.fault_budget: Each observed fault<=250ms; n3 is not used to claim p95<=100ms or an upper bound.
boundaries.group_comparability: Do not pool with prior independent PipeWire n30 or pre-fix host run. Seed/background load not controlled; no paired speedup claim.
